name: Ushiromiya Battler
source:
Battler seems to enjoy his time on the island. He really loves the summer camp atmosphere. But that doesn't mean he can't get serious when his team is in need.
...Though most of the time, he is too late.
Battler often ignores his sister without even noticing. He is very insensitive and has one X girlfriend on the island which he cannot remember. He cares for his teammates and often believes the lies told by them.
